CLARK COUNTY, Ky. (LEX 18)-- Eight people indicted in a Clark County shooting that took the lives of two 16-year-old girls in November pleaded not guilty in court Thursday. 
Jessica Burton, Mikaela Buford, Matthew Carmen, Ronnie Ellis, Denzel Hill, Darian Skinner and Julia Richardson all pleaded not guilty to their charges. 
They're all accused of playing a role in the deaths of Kayla Holland and Adrianna Castro, who were shot in the parking lot of the Washington Street Apartments in Winchester.
